1251-2023-4289-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2063-4591-8089.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-1477-5131-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-1477-5131-7010--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

6633-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6633-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6633-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
969-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

3129-5086-5183-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-5086-5183-5231-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2104-4863-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Revolutionist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
2116-6797-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

240-1251-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

489-586-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4053-4336-5231-6989.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

14-147-2511.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

2604-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1395-3518-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

654-3293-5411-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
654-3293-5411-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
654-3293-5411-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

488-641-2478-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Mishra's Bauble or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-2478-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1550-4251-5223.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-5223.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

719-1238-2351-3967-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

791-2474-3693.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-2474-3693.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 3 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 2.

855-1920-2060-4222-5328.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
855-1920-2060-4222-5328.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

1988-3197-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Herd Baloth.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-3197-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

500-4688-4772-4840.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, creating thirty-two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1283-2585-3525-4785.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Dynaheir by tapping it, copying the next ability that you activate that costs at least four mana this turn.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}.
Dynaheir triggers, copying Grim Monolith's ability.
Resolve the copy of Grim Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {3}.
Resolve Grim Monolith's ability from step 4, untapping it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Dynaheir.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1651-1737.notablePrerequisites: Any artifact with mana value 0 exiled by Prototype Portal.
851-1651-1737.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating two token copies of the imprinted artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two artifact tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

238-4050-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
238-4050-5140.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing Gerrard and five other creatures, adding {5}{B}.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use it to activate Kenrith's other abilities.

851-2367-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1167-1915.notablePrerequisites: The opponent after you in turn order has a life total that is divisible by 5.
1167-1915.description:
Cast Volrath's Dungeon for {2}{B}{B}.
Target the opponent who's turn is after yours with Mindslaver.
On their turn, force them to pay 5 life to destroy Volrath's Dungeon while holding priority.
With the destroy trigger on the stack, repeat this process until they have 0 life.

209-233-714.description:
Urborg turns all lands into Swamps.
Kormus Bell turns all swamps into creatures.
Linvala prevents your opponent' creatures from activating their abilities, including mana abilities.

757-2003-2402.notablePrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it.
757-2003-2402.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Nesting Grounds's last ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Magosi to Nesting Grounds.
Activate Magosi's last ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it to your hand, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi from your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Nesting Grounds.
Activate Nesting Grounds's last ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Nesting Grounds to Magosi.
Repeat from step 3.
